qualifications: Three rotated trials, 64 timed file replacements and 64 four-entry directory moves per rename cell. Only rename syscall time is summed; setup and untimed final move excluded.

Digest cell uses 16 MiB edited file and two same-size content generations, 64 size probes and 64 value calls per algorithm per generation. SHA1 values are requested first, so BLAKE3 values reuse the pair.
Strict exact work counters include untimed correctness/chmod/remount checks; cache-hit totals distinguish size queries from actual values.
Loopback digest mapping fixture is not the actual Git proxy. No Bazel or remote actions in this workload.
All byte, inode, overwritten-open descriptor, native-path journal, status and remount checks passed. No Cargo/heavy jobs overlapped accepted timed cells.
